messages:
yue: heads-up — onboarding eval for naga-int6 on our mixed zh/ko/ja subtitle suite shows intermittent disappearance of U+200D (ZWJ) when requests use prefix caching + nucleus sampling. BLEU ~-3 on affected lines. Repro: `./evals/run.py --suite locale/multisubs-mixed --model naga --quant int6 --seed 99`

ci-bot: CI job `evals/naga-int6-3278901234` completed: regressions detected. Artifacts: /ci/artifacts/3278901234/summary.json

marco: Reproed locally. fp16 baseline keeps ZWJ. int6 drops ZWJ in ~0.7% of lines, mostly where cached prefix ends exactly before the joiner. Looks sampling-sensitive (top_p >= 0.6).

chen: Can you paste a tiny example + token dump?

yue: example below:
```
# src: "中国‍クリス"
# tokens: [412:"中", 2:"‍", 701:"ク", 702:"リ", 703:"ス"]
# fp16: "中国‍クリス"
# int6 (fail): "中国クリス"  <-- ZWJ gone
```

ara: interesting—two quick suspects: 1) int6 kvcache stitching + sampling numeric precision (invisible token score drops below pruning threshold), 2) detok post-process in int6 build differs (we rolled detok to v2.7 in build).

marco: i reran disabling kvcache and the issue vanishes. disabling sampling (greedy) also removes the failure. so it's the kvcache+sampling interaction.

chen: add a quick mitigation: route flag `preserve_zero_width: true` OR pin impacted customers to fp16. Config example:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: naga-protect-multisub
    model: naga:int6
    filters: ["locale:zh","locale:ja","locale:ko"]
    decode_options:
      preserve_zero_width: true
```

yue: i've added a small reproducer gist with traces: https://internal.redwood/snapshots/3278901234/naga-zwj-repro and opened a draft PR that adds the route flag + unit test.

ara: i'll run a bisect across the int6 kernel commits around kvcache-sampling optimizations: `scripts/bisect_kernel.sh --model naga --artifact int6 --range kernel-1.8..kernel-2.0` and also bisect detok v2.6..v2.7. if kernel change, patch might be adjusting sampling floor for flagged invisibles.

marco: for customer comms i'll suggest pin to fp16 or enable the route flag. label the PR `customer-impact` if we flip routing.

chen: i'll also instrument the stitcher to emit pre/post token scores for invisible ids when kvcache is used. that should tell us if numeric rounding is to blame.

yue: plan: immediate routing mitigation today (config-only) + unit test. bisect + kernel fix next sprint. thanks all. :thumbsup:
